summary: Inventiva S.A., a French foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for June 30, 2026. The meeting covers routine items such as approval of annual financial statements, compensation policies, and director renewals, with amended resolutions primarily affecting share issuance ceilings and the addition of a warrant issuance to the European Investment Bank. No special-situation corporate event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change—is disclosed. This is a standard shareholder meeting notice.
